description: This Java class 'LoginWorker' provides core functionality for handling user login, logout, impersonation, session management, and related security features within the OFBIZ web application framework. It manages login URLs, session security, cookies, JWT tokens, impersonation workflows, and integrates with services like userLogin, password management, and permission checks.

classes.name: LoginWorker
classes.description: Final utility class providing static methods for user authentication, session management, impersonation workflows, token handling, and related security operations within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: makeLoginUrl
methods.description: Generates a URL for logging in, optionally including current view and parameters.

methods.name: setLoggedOut
methods.description: Marks a user login as logged out in the database and manages transaction control.

methods.name: checkLogout
methods.description: Checks if the current user is logged out or invalid and performs logout if necessary.

methods.name: checkImpersonationInProcess
methods.description: Returns the impersonation login history if an impersonation session is active, or null otherwise.

methods.name: extensionCheckLogin
methods.description: Calls custom 'LoginCheck' services, then defaults to checkLogin route.

methods.name: extensionConnectLogin
methods.description: Calls custom 'LoginCheck' services, then defaults to success.

methods.name: checkLogin
methods.description: Verifies user login status, processes login parameters, manages session and permissions.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Processes user login, handles password decryption, delegator setup, calls 'userLogin' service, manages session and cookies.

methods.name: impersonateLogin
methods.description: Allows an authorized user to impersonate another userLogin without password.

methods.name: depersionateLogin
methods.description: Reverses impersonation, restoring the original user session.

methods.name: setWebContextObjects
methods.description: Sets request and session attributes for delegator, security, and dispatcher.

methods.name: doMainLogin
methods.description: Handles the final login procedures, setting session attributes, cookies, preferences.

methods.name: doBasicLogin
methods.description: Stores user login info in session, initializes preferences and related entities.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Performs logout operations, invalidates session, resets context, and triggers logout events.

methods.name: doBasicLogout
methods.description: Clears session data, marks user as logged out, resets cookies, and optionally calls logout on security system.

methods.name: autoLoginSet
methods.description: Creates cookies for auto login and JWT tokens if configured.

methods.name: createSecuredLoginIdCookie
methods.description: Sets a secure cookie with the userLoginId for session identification.

methods.name: createSecuredLoginJwtCookie
methods.description: Sets a JWT token in a cookie to share authentication with other services or web apps.

methods.name: getAutoLoginCookieName
methods.description: Constructs the cookie name for the auto-login cookie based on application name.

methods.name: getSecuredLoginIdCookieName
methods.description: Constructs the cookie name for secured login ID based on application name.

methods.name: getAutoUserLoginId
methods.description: Retrieves the auto login user ID from cookies.

methods.name: getSecuredUserLoginId
methods.description: Retrieves the secured login ID from cookies.

methods.name: getSecuredUserLoginByJWT
methods.description: Decodes JWT token from cookie and authenticates it to retrieve the userLoginId.

methods.name: autoLoginCheck
methods.description: Checks session for autoUserLogin, attempts auto login if not present.

methods.name: securedUserLoginByJWTCookie
methods.description: Authenticates a userLogin by JWT token in cookie.

methods.name: autoLoginRemove
methods.description: Removes auto-login cookies and session attributes, logs out user if logged in.

methods.name: isUserLoggedIn
methods.description: Checks if the current session has a valid logged-in user.

methods.name: loginUserWithUserLoginId
methods.description: Logs in a user based solely on their userLoginId, updating session and cookies appropriately.
